Apple and Pomegranate Fresh Salad
By: AngellovesCooking
Published: Monday, January 3, 2011 - 5:39am

Ingredients




2 sour apples, peeled and cored
1 seeds of midsize pomegranate
2 tablespoons honey
1/2 juice of lemon, freshly squeezed
1/2 cup almonds (may be slightly toasted)
few fresh leaves of salad (lettuce, iceberg, Chinese cabbage

Preparation

1 Dice the peeled and cored apples and mix with pomegranate seeds. 2 Mix well together honey and lemon and season. 3 Add almonds and mix. 4 Serve over fresh leaf salad, which also can pre-season lightly with honey and lemon dressing. 5 Serve as an appetizer or side dish with meat...

About


Very light and pleasant salad :)
